## Context / Problem
The .github cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in the listed locations. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints while retaining every preserve item and consumer contract. The visible pull-request template is user-facing documentation and is not subject to ticket-style terseness; only its redundant hidden routing comment is in scope.

## Scope
- `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml:1-10` — Preserve that `docs/**` is excluded because it is non-shipping prose/experiments and that the default query suite is unchanged. Consumers: `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`, packaging policy, CodeQL maintainers.
- `.github/dependabot.yml:1-29` — Preserve the advisory-PR posture because Gerrit lands code; enabled GitHub Actions and uv ecosystems; the deliberate cooldown omission; and the `mcp` major-version ignore with its removal condition. Consumers: Dependabot, the lockdown exception, `CONTRIBUTING.md:673`, and `docs/releasing.md:585-589`.
- `.github/pull_request_template.md:1-6` — At most a short hidden Gerrit-routing reminder may be condensed. Preserve all visible contributor instructions and links outside those lines unchanged. Consumers: GitHub contributors and the documentation-link gate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Every consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] No executable behavior changes; verified by inspecting the final diff and running the command under Verification.
- [ ] No visible user-facing documentation or test assertion changes; verified by inspecting the final diff.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
